candidates.name: Tina Kotek
candidates.bio: Governor of Oregon since 2023 and a former speaker of the Oregon House.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed HB 4088 protecting abortion seekers and providers and HB 4127 funding Planned Parenthood (2026)
source.quote: protect Oregonians from federal attempts to restrict access to abortion

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek opposed overturning Roe v. Wade
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek is fully supportive of Oregon's Climate Protection Program, which caps emissions
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed the Climate Resilience Investment Act
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek pledges clean air and water and backed restoring salmon protections
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek directed the state to expand and speed up police training
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed HB 4002 (2024), recriminalizing small-amount drug possession while allowing deflection into treatment
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek opposes public money for private schools and opted Oregon out of the federal scholarship tax credit (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek supported the 2022 measure creating a state constitutional right to affordable health care
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed HB 2010 (2025), extending the taxes that fund Oregon's Medicaid program
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek would team up with other states to lower prescription drug costs
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek defended Oregon's sanctuary law and signed eight bills in 2026 protecting immigrants from federal enforcement
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed unemployment benefits for striking workers (SB 916, 2025) and required project labor agreements on state construction
source.quote: I'm proud to stand with working people.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek signed HB 4088, protecting providers of gender-affirming care (2026)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek opposed the Supreme Court ruling letting states bar transgender athletes from girls' sports
source.quote: our LGBTQ+ community from federal attacks

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek voted in 2016 to raise Oregon's minimum wage in steps through 2022 (SB 1532)
source.quote: All workers deserve fair, living wages.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Kotek would safeguard vote-by-mail and opposes federal limits on mail voting
source.quote: It's safe, it's secure, and it works.

candidates.name: Christine Drazan
candidates.bio: Oregon state representative, a former House Republican leader and the 2022 Republican nominee for governor.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan calls herself pro-life and said in 2022 she would veto bills expanding abortion rights
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan calls Oregon's abortion law an outlier but does not support a ban
source.quote: I do not support banning abortion.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan would rescind Oregon's Climate Protection Program on her first day
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan voted against banning the pesticide chlorpyrifos (2020)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan on public safety
source.quote: We need fewer needles and more cops to restore safe communities.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan on public safety
source.quote: We need fewer needles and more cops to restore safe communities.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan supports opting Oregon into the federal private school tax credit and would expand school choice
source.quote: We urgently need more options for students and their families to succeed.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan opposed the 2022 measure creating a state constitutional right to affordable health care
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan voted against HB 2010 (2025), which extended the taxes that fund Oregon's Medicaid program
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan voted against creating a Prescription Drug Affordability Board (SB 844, 2021)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan sponsored HB 3551, letting state police work with federal agencies to locate immigrants convicted of certain crimes
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan calls Oregon's sanctuary status off the rails and backed the 2025 federal troop deployment to Portland
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan voted against unemployment benefits for striking workers (SB 916, 2025) and against easing union organizing (HB 2016, 2019)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan sponsored HB 3740, barring transgender athletes from girls' school sports
source.quote: No more boys in girls' sports.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan supports bold tax cuts for families and businesses and more child care tax credits
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan would eliminate Oregon's estate tax
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan introduced HB 3872, requiring photo ID to vote or request a ballot (2025)
guides.vote, 2026 Oregon governor voters guide: Drazan introduced HB 3872 to replace vote-by-mail with in-person voting, though she says she has always supported vote by mail
